Spring Webinar Series
What is TAICEP’s Spring Webinar Series?
Advance Your Expertise with the TAICEP Spring Webinar Series
Join a global community of your peers for the TAICEP Spring Webinar Series, a premier training and development opportunity for professionals in international credential evaluation. This series will provide critical training and connection opportunities for our diverse community, which includes professionals from higher education institutions, independent evaluation agencies, ENIC/NARIC offices, government ministries, and licensing and awarding bodies. Building on the success of our highly rated past events, this series is designed to deliver timely insights and practical skills.
The 2027 Series theme is
Back to Basics: Country Systems.
Hear what past attendees have to say:
“I have found this webinar series to be extremely helpful. I would participate in these webinars all year long if they were offered. So very grateful to have the opportunity to participate and learn such valuable information.”
“I really enjoyed the webinars and learned a lot. Looking forward to next spring!”
Series Details:
When:
Thursdays, 10:30 AM (Eastern US), beginning March 4, 2027
What:
A series of 10 expert-led webinars is planned (60-75 minutes each)
Access:
One affordable package rate grants you access to all live webinars, presentation materials, and session recordings to view at your convenience.
Webinar Proposals Due Date:
Tuesday, December 15, 2026
REGISTER NOW!
Spring Webinar Series Archive
Registered attendees can access recordings on the SWS website shortly after each session. These remain exclusive to registrants for six months before being archived on our TAICEP wiki as a permanent resource for our full membership.
